data.name: Aniket Ambarte
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Aniket Ambarte has made a big mark in cricket. With 19 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 24, with an average of 10.73 and a quick strike rate of 126.77. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 8 sixes and 17 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 8.0 overs, taking 3 wickets at an economy rate of 5.50. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
